cards.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the ORIGINAL Slay the Spire 2 card illustration (a Silent card) and the strict EDIT TARGET. Reinterpret the replaced subject as a specific Persona 5 Royal moment, character or object, while the card stays instantly recognizable at thumbnail size: same silhouettes, same action, same footprint, same camera. Do NOT redraw the scene, do NOT recolor globally, do NOT move or rescale anything beyond what is stated. Wherever the Silent (the green-hooded huntress) appears, remove her completely with no remnants (no green hood, skull-like face, green cloak or pouches left) and refill the cleared area with the original background shapes, unless this prompt replaces her with someone. If the original composition cannot fit the idea literally, keep the composition and adapt the idea to it. Every named character MUST match the attached reference images exactly: face shape, eyes, hairstyle and hair color, mask, outfit, weapon; do not invent features or change their look; if a detail is unclear, keep it simple rather than guess. Match the original's rich hard cel-shading: crisp dark outlines, deep near-black occlusion planes, clear midtone and lit planes, material thickness; no blur, no soft glow, no photoreal rendering. A SHADOW (P5R enemy, no reference image) is drawn as: a hunched black sludge-like body with drippy edges and a smooth white oval mask with two narrow slanted eye slits; keep it simple and consistent. Keep important features inside x8-92%, y10-85% (crop-safe). Output: opaque, full-bleed, the same size as Image1, no text, letters, numbers, frame, UI or watermark. Keep the composition of scattered tools; the tools become Phantom Thieves tools: JOKER's knife, lockpicks, a grappling hook, calling cards. Keep the blue background. No characters.
